creator_name.note: One entry per person credited for this dataset, as they want to be credited. Required. Published: it travels with every copy of the dataset.

creator_orcid.note: One entry per creator who has an ORCID, in the same order as creator_name. Optional. Published. Leave the list empty if none of you wants one recorded.

creator_affiliation.note: Each creator's affiliation as it stands today, in the same order as creator_name. Optional. Published. It is recorded as stated at deposit and is not updated later.

contact_address.note: An address for questions about this dataset. Optional. Published only if it belongs to a role, such as a group or a facility address. A personal address given here is stored on the operator's machine and is not published.
contact_address.where: published only where it is a role address

depositor_name.note: You, the person sending this deposit. Required. Local: it stays on the operator's machine and is never written into the dataset.

depositor_email.note: Where the operator answers you, including if the deposit is refused. Required. Local.

depositor_institution.note: Your institution and its address. Optional. Local.
